measurement.reviews: Two independent Fable/high static reviews found no blockers.

limits: Rows touch distinct experts, so both work and weight footprint grow.
Prefix routes give smaller counts different cache reuse.
Host timing includes dispatch and evaluation, not isolated GPU counters.
The additional 24 bank rows use production output as their oracle, not an independent per-expert comparison.
No model throughput ceiling or speedup follows from these component timings.
